tpms.when: 2016–2022 with the tire pressure warning reset (SET) switch on the instrument panel
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Park and turn the ignition to ON.
Find the tire pressure warning reset switch, marked SET, on the instrument panel. The dash diagram in the owner's manual shows where it is on your truck.
Press and hold the SET switch until the tire pressure light blinks 3 times, then let go.
Let the truck sit for a few minutes so the system can finish setting up.
Then drive for about 10 minutes at roughly 25 mph or faster.
tpms.note: If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault. A reset will not clear it; have it checked.
